text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E in pieces locked in gains, but a profitable sale alone does not show that the timing was right; weigh the outlook and the role it plays in my portfolio.","I should avoid letting the pleasure of realizing gains drive repeated sales while neglecting diversification and the long-term plan.","With only a few account check-ins and rare trading, set clear rules in advance and avoid overreacting to short-term account changes."]}
